TRANSPARENCY FIRST

Know what’s behind the number.

Sources, dates, and the limits of this planning prototype.

Income limits are program specific

California's 2026 State Income Limits took effect June 23, 2026. State, State HOME, and HUD tables are not interchangeable. This prototype does not claim income eligibility or import a limit table.

California HCD · State and federal income limits ↗

Mortgage assumptions

The calculator starts at an illustrative 6.50%, entered by the user. It is not a current published rate. Use the dated Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey as a reference, then obtain a lender quote.

Freddie Mac · PMMS archive ↗

How the gap is calculated

Monthly P&I budget = annual gross income ÷ 12 × housing ratio − monthly taxes, insurance and HOA. Affordable loan = present value of 360 monthly payments. Buyer purchasing power = affordable loan + down payment. Remaining gap = max(0, cost − purchasing power − committed subsidy).

Project cards and commitments are fictional demonstration data. This is a planning estimate, not a statutory affordable-cost calculation, loan approval, program eligibility decision, or verified funding stack. No program combinations are assumed. Repayment, lien priority, affordability covenants, funds availability, debt-to-income and lender underwriting require individual review.
